address: 960 avenue du Léman, à Neuvecelle, Évian-les-Bains, 74500, France
bio: Take a seat in the majestic dining room of this luxury hotel and admire the Art nouveau frescoes by Gustave Jaulmes. The show continues in your plate, as you tuck into dishes, subtly and precisely crafted with premium ingredients: fish from Lake Geneva (arctic char, perch, crayfish...), Bresse chicken with yellow wine. The modest, enthusiastic chef, Patrice Vander, works only with noble produce, delving freely and frequently into the estate’s cottage garden. The exclusive, sophisticated ambience, like the breathtaking view and the attentive service add the final touch to this fine dining experience rich in gourmet memories....
